title: U.S. state banking associations plan to launch their own nationwide blockchain network
summary: The "BankChain Alliance" is aiming for a 2027 launch, and would foster stablecoins, payments and tokenized deposits inside the banking system's regulatory sphere.

title: Zerohash back for second effort at OCC trust bank charter
summary: The crypto infrastructure firm failed to get approval when it first sought a U.S. charter, and the company is quickly back with what it said would be a narrower effort.

title: South Korea trade giant POSCO brings trade receivables to Avalanche in latest tokenization move
summary: The $22 billion trading company worked with Olea and Intain on the transaction, following an Injective pilot with LG CNS last month.

title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
summary: The trading infrastructure runs on LayerZero's Zero blockchain, backed by Citadel Securities with DTCC and ICE exploring institutional market applications.

title: Bitwise turns Coinbase's tokenized stocks into automated AI, robotics and tech portfolios
summary: The crypto ETF issuer is pushing deeper into onchain asset management as tokenization create new ways to build and manage investments.
